title.narrative: IOM - The Regional Routes to Resilience Programme (R2R)
IOM - The Regional Routes to Resilience Programme (R2R)

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the Regional Routes to Resilience (R2R) Programme is to strengthen protection, stabilization and rights-based return and sustainable reintegration outcomes for migrants, returnees, and affected communities along the Central Mediterranean Route targeting four key countries along the route- Sudan, Egypt, Libya, and Tunisia.
To achieve the stated objective, the programme is structured around three complementary pillars:
1. strengthening route-level data and analysis through Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM) tools, protection monitoring, and conflict sensitivity analysis to support evidence-based decision-making and coordinated responses.
2. delivering integrated, multi-sectoral assistance to migrants and communities, including protection services, mental health and psychosocial support, livelihoods support, basic services, and return and reintegration assistance, while promoting social cohesion and community resilience in areas of transit and return
3. Strengthening governance and coordination by supporting the development of a Central Mediterranean Route (CMR) Operational Response Plan, providing a shared framework for policy alignment, joint planning, and operational coherence across stakeholders.

Insatsen kommer att genomföras längs den centrala Medelhavsrutten (CMR) i Libyen, Tunisien, Egypten och Sudan, med huvudsyftet att stärka stabilisering och skydd, ett rättighetsbaserat återvändande, en hållbar återintegrering och förbättrat gränsöverskridande samarbete längs migrationsrutterna.

The project will be implemented along the Central Mediterranean route in Sudan, Egypt, Libya and Tunisia. The main objectives are to strengthen protection, stabilization, rights-based return and sustainable reintegration, as well as cross-border cooperation along the migration routes.
